## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and owning runtime(s).

## Verification

List exact commands and results, including skipped checks. Link the task ledger
and relevant receipts/screenshots. For a dirty-tree run, identify the patch tested.

## Remaining acceptance

Name any required browser, Redis, native, live-auth, packaging, visual, accessibility,
or performance checks that have not run. Write “None” only when the change's required
acceptance is complete. State any deployment/configuration steps.
